NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

ServerError.title: Something went wrong
ServerError.body: Please try again in a moment. If the problem continues, contact us.

TwoFactor.setupIntro: Staff accounts must use two-step verification. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
TwoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
TwoFactor.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
TwoFactor.verifyIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Elite Tech Academy.

ForgotPassword.title: Reset your password
ForgotPassword.intro: Enter the email of your account. If it exists, we will send a link to reset your password.
ForgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for this email, a reset link is on its way. The link is valid for 30 minutes.

ResetPassword.title: Choose a new password
ResetPassword.hint: At least 10 characters. A long phrase is easy to remember and hard to guess.
ResetPassword.done: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in.
ResetPassword.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Please use the full link from the email, or request a new one.

Invite.title: Welcome to Elite Tech Academy
Invite.intro: Choose a password to activate your account.
Invite.done: Your account is ready. You can now sign in.

Account.title: Welcome, {firstName}
Account.intro: You are signed in. Your area is being built and will appear here soon.
Account.adminIntro: The admin area will be available in a later release.
